package.description: WebSocket relay server bridging Adobe Photoshop to iOS devices

en-US.description: WebSocket relay server bridging Adobe Photoshop to iOS devices
en-US.longDescription: Mirror for Photoshop Server is a WebSocket relay that connects Adobe Photoshop to iOS devices for real-time preview. It enables the Photoshop plugin to transmit preview images to connected iOS clients via Bonjour/mDNS discovery.
en-US.name: Mirror for Photoshop Server
